name: Lilac
team: Ekaterina Morozova, Aida Babayeva, Gunay Mammadova
about: Cobalt architects were tasked with creating a design for a flower retail store located in the heart of Baku. The design of the new store had a very clear concept of allowing the customers to shop in a comfy way and feel the atmosphere where simplicity is revealed with elegance.

architecture.description: The experience in terms of service had to have a positive impact on the client and its behaviors towards the process. Cobalt deliberately inserts new design elements to embody the brand: young and exquisite. The entire store is built of three main materials, in their raw, pure state - concrete, wood boards, and galvanized steel. The ensemble of each part results in a welcoming place of great warmth and finish, defined by the qualities of the materials, the carefully crafted details, and its lighting.
